about.title: We are Jelly. Driven by purpose and change.
about.lead: Behind every click there are real people, concrete challenges and dreams waiting to happen. For 15 years we have connected branding, marketing, communications and technology — with teams that work together, not in silos.
about.manifestoTitle: When the vision is clear, strategy is easy.
about.manifestoBody: We don't follow trends: we generate change. We work with data because it forces us to be honest, and with creativity because data alone moves nobody. Every project starts with a number to hit — and that number is what we answer for.
about.teamNote: Roles and portraits come from the CMS.
about.methodBody: Diagnose, decide, deliver, measure. Short cycles, one person accountable per front, and a report that says what changes next week.
about.careersBody: We look for people who would rather decide than wait. Open applications and roles at talent@jelly.pt.
